workstream.note: Numerical rationale expansion only. Does not register v2 or amend v1.

attributionEvidence.summary: N2 production GPU f32 vs CPU f64 maxAbsoluteError equals local CPU f32 proxy vs CPU f64 exactly (9.169177409562579e-7). Air ratio ~0.82. Near-zero states do not dominate. First v1-threshold crossing at step 6. Implementation defect not supported.

stateScale.description: Normalized populations / dimensionless intensities on O(1) for dominant species; early singletO2 can be near zero.
stateScale.binary32UlpNote: ulp(1.0f) = 2^-23 ≈ 1.192e-7. Four ULPs ≈ 4.768e-7 used as implementation absolute bound.

time.note: dt and step count are those of the fitted golden RK4 trajectory (factor 1×); refinement multiplies step count while holding finalTime fixed.

accumulationModel.statement: Each RK4 step performs a fixed number of binary32 fused multiply-adds and rounded divisions. Local truncation is O(dt^5) in exact arithmetic; floating-point local error is O(eps) times state and rate scales. Global f32–f64 state drift grows roughly with step count when the same ODE is integrated with identical coefficients.
accumulationModel.implication: Halving dt (factor 2, 4) increases the number of binary32 updates, so max |CPU32−CPU64| is expected to non-decrease; the scientific RMSE decision must remain stable (still fail model fit under v1 scientific criteria).

stepSizeAnalysis.rationale: v2 refinementCheck requires factors 1,2,4 at fixed final time and conclusion stability so step-size-driven f32 accumulation cannot be used to claim scientific agreement with f64.

derivation.relativeBound: absoluteBound / unitScale = 4.768e-7 when |x|≥1; floored relative uses max(|x|, 1e-4) so bound ≈ 4.768e-7/1e-4 = 4.768e-3 at the floor
derivation.productionGpuMinusCpu32Ulp: Air ≤ ~1 ULP (1.19e-7); N2 ≤ ~0.5 ULP (5.96e-8) in prior diagnosis

backendImplementationEquivalence.rationale: Four binary32 epsilons at unit state scale permit arithmetic contraction/order differences while detecting equation, coefficient, indexing, or state-update regressions. Production GPU–CPU32 residual was ≤1 unit-scale ULP (1.19e-7); 4 ulp leaves headroom without masking a wrong update. The denominator floor prevents near-zero states from dominating (observed near-zero max abs ≤ ~1e-12).

scientificEquivalence.rationale: The observed worst RMSE delta was 1.27e-7. A 1e-5 bound is far below the 0.08 scientific fit threshold and leaves more than an order of magnitude regression margin. CPU f32 and production GPU preserve the model-fit failure by a wide margin (RMSE > 0.55).

refinementCheck.rationale: Halving dt increases f32–f64 state drift because more binary32 updates accumulate; refinement must not flip the scientific decision.

separationFromV1.whyV1Failed: v1 compared GPU f32 trajectories to CPU f64 with tolerances tighter than binary32 accumulation over hundreds of steps; failure is expected under correct f32 RK4 and is preserved as a frozen negative result.

freezeRequirements: Review the numerical rationale independently (dimensions, ULP derivation, step accumulation).
Add the draft and diagnostic report digests to the versioned manifest.
Assign a registration timestamp before the first v2 formal run.
